description: If \(R\) is a primitive-recursive relation and \(f,g\) are primitive recursive, the function choosing \(f\) when \(R\) holds and \(g\) otherwise is primitive recursive.
signature:
Primrec.ite.{u_1, u_3} {α : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_3} [Primcodable α] [Primcodable σ] {c : α → Prop} [DecidablePred c]
  {f g : α → σ} (hc : PrimrecPred c) (hf : Primrec f) (hg : Primrec g) : Primrec fun a => if c a then f a else g a
